tasks.objective: Propose revised isogeny-transfer mechanisms for SG-ECDLP-002 that avoid the class-invariant obstruction. Address DIR-2 (non-invariant special families) or DIR-3 (within-class reformulation). Each proposal must include: (1) a falsifiable experimental test, (2) a mechanism that avoids the Tate theorem obstruction, (3) explicit dominated_by / sota_delta comparison against Pollard rho. If no viable mechanism is identified, recommend formally closing SG-ECDLP-002 with a named obstruction.
completion_gate: At least one proposal with falsifiable experimental test
Explicit dominated_by / sota_delta vs Pollard rho
OR recommendation to close SG-ECDLP-002 with named obstruction
